metadata.name: xml_single_record_sample_rules
metadata.description: Business rules for the XML single-record worked example (ADR 0019). Mirrors the JSON sample: a required attribute path, a valid_values allowlist, a numeric type, and an array-length minimum on the parser's count column.

rules.name: CUSTOMER_ID required (attribute present)
rules.description: The customer/@id attribute must be present. Flags record 9 (no id attribute).

rules.name: STATUS valid values
rules.description: Account status must be one of the allowlist. Flags record 8 ('FROZEN').
rules.message: STATUS must be one of ACTIVE/CLOSED/SUSPENDED

rules.name: AGE numeric
rules.description: Age must be numeric. Flags record 10 ('NaN').

rules.name: At least one transaction
rules.description: Every customer must carry at least one transaction. Runs xml_array_length against the TXN_COUNT_count column the parser emits from the repeated transactions/transaction child. Flags record 6 (empty transactions).
rules.message: Each record must carry at least one transaction
